And this probability increases with noise interference, sure, but it increases also if we use large signal constellations. Okay. So the point here is that, in order to increase the bit rate, the speed at which we transfer bits from the transmitter to the receiver, on the one hand, of course, we would like to increase the constellation set because it means that increasing the number of signals that are available, we can increase the number of bits that each signal can carry. On the other hand, if we increase the constellation set, the signals that get close to each other, and the error probability at the receiver increases as well. So the main point is, we need to vary the type of constellation, so the type of modulation that we are using, depending on the wireless channel.
